problem: A,B,C,D = construct_r_trapezoid_q(60,100,10), E = construct_on_dia(A,D), E = construct_lc_tangent(A,C)
necessary_constructions: A,B,C,D = construct_r_trapezoid_q(60,100,10), E = construct_on_dia(A,D), E = construct_lc_tangent(A,C)
proof:
Solution:
1. Perpendicular(A,C,A,E) => Angle_C_A_E - pi/2
2. Angle_B_A_D - pi/2 => Perpendicular(A,B,A,D)
3. Perpendicular(A,B,A,D) & Parallel(A,B,C,D) => Perpendicular(A,D,C,D)
4. Perpendicular(A,D,C,D) => Angle_A_D_C - pi/2
5. Angle_C_A_D - Angle_C_A_E + Angle_D_A_E & Angle_C_A_E - pi/2 & Angle_A_D_C - pi/2 & Angle_A_C_D + Angle_A_D_C + Angle_C_A_D - pi => Angle_A_C_D - Angle_D_A_E
6. Perpendicular(A,E,D,E) => Angle_A_E_D - pi/2
7. Angle_A_D_C - pi/2 & Angle_A_E_D - pi/2 => Angle_A_D_C - Angle_A_E_D
8. Angle_A_C_D - Angle_D_A_E & Angle_A_D_C - Angle_A_E_D => Similar3(A,C,D,D,A,E)
9. Similar3(A,C,D,D,A,E) => Length_A_C/Length_C_D - Length_A_D/Length_A_E
10. Length_A_C/Length_C_D - Length_A_D/Length_A_E => Length_A_E/Length_A_D - Length_C_D/Length_A_C
11. Angle_C_A_E - pi/2 => Area_A_C_E - Length_A_C*Length_A_E/2
12. Length_A_E/Length_A_D - Length_C_D/Length_A_C & Area_A_C_E - Length_A_C*Length_A_E/2 & Length_C_D - 10 & Length_A_D - 100 => Area_A_C_E - 500
